thread:
maria: Short thread to lock GA acceptance items. Need final owners for SLA wording, public pricing exposure, support rota, monitoring retention, and the short AE handout. GA target: 2 weeks. Call out blockers now.
dave: SLA draft: Paid 99.9% monthly, Enterprise 99.95%, Trial best-effort. SLOs split by surface (generation vs embeddings). Will PR precise text and a sample credit calculation.
harpreet: Support plan: reinforced coverage first 72h (12h overlapping shifts), then hand back to standard oncall. I'll own rota and the launch-pager channel.
sarah: Docs & AE: will update quickstarts (Py/JS) and write a one-page "what to tell customers" including migration notes for Dedicated customers. ETA Fri EOD.
bot-deploy: deploy-bot: Canary scheduled 2024-01-20T05:00Z. Smoke: 120rps x 20m. Auto-rollback triggers: error_rate >= 3% for 6m OR p95 > 700ms for 10m. Alerts to #launch-run and #launch-pager.
maria: Monitoring asks: critical metrics scrape 15s for first 72h, traces 14d retention, logs 21d. Alerts: token_error_rate > 0.35% (5m), p95 > 180ms (10m), cache_hit drop > 15% absolute. Need dashboard owners + runbooks.
dave: Rollback/fallback policy: soft-fallback to quantized-small variant, then reduce max_tokens for new sessions, then circuit-breaker rejecting new sessions (429). I'll add the appendix explaining how fallbacks affect availability accounting.
harpreet: I'll pin runbook links in launch-pager and create runbook IDs. Also setting temporary increased scrape frequency for critical metrics during the window.
sarah: Pricing: publish RU bands for Hobby/Team and keep Enterprise contact-only until FinOps signs off. Also include burst-cap language and a short note on Dedicated reserved plans. Coordinating with FinOps now.
maria: Open risks: burst autoscale bills, silent quality regressions post-quantization, SDK docs lag. Actions: Dave -> SLA + rollback annex; Sarah -> docs + AE sheet; Harpreet -> support rota + runbooks; Maria -> comms/legal checklist. Confirm by EOD Wed.
dave: Ack, PRing SLA + appendix today.
harpreet: Ack, posting rota and runbook links shortly.
sarah: Ack, drafting docs now.
bot-deploy: note: retain launch metrics under project-id for extended retention per ops request.
maria: Thanks all. If no objections we lock defaults by EOD Wed and schedule a dry-run Friday.
